# Town of Sudbury municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 23; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): names Shaun Ketcham (Chair), Travis Romano, and Thomas Williams for Sudbury's three-member board. The town has no website (sudburyvt.org is a parked domain and sudburyvt.gov does not resolve), so the directory is the roster of record. Selectboard member Thomas Williams and Justice of the Peace Tim Williams share the address 2425 Route 30 in the state sources; they are recorded as distinct people, identity unproven
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Steve Sgorbati as Sudbury's Town Clerk

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names the clerk as 'Stevie Sgorbati,' a diminutive artifact; the Guide, the treasurer spreadsheet, and the certified justices of the peace listing all read Steve Sgorbati, which governs
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Steve Sgorbati as Sudbury's Town Treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Steve Sgorbati as Sudbury's Town Treasurer
